mapper.select: SELECT rp.permission_code, COALESCE(p.permission_name, rp.permission_code) AS permission_name, p.permission_type, p.status, rp.grant_time FROM sys_role_permission rp LEFT JOIN sys_permission p ON p.permission_code = rp.permission_code WHERE rp.role_code = #{roleCode} ORDER BY rp.permission_code

SELECT r.role_code, r.role_name, r.status, r.role_type, rp.grant_time FROM sys_role_permission rp INNER JOIN sys_role r ON r.role_code = rp.role_code WHERE rp.permission_code = #{permissionCode} ORDER BY r.role_code
mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO sys_role_permission (role_code, permission_code, grant_time, grantor_id, create_user, update_user, version) VALUES
(#{roleCode}, #{permissionCode}, NOW(3), #{grantorId}, #{createUser}, #{createUser}, 0)
